selected_evidence.requirement: Persistently disable IPv4 ICMP redirect and source-route acceptance
selected_evidence.summary: Pre-change values were captured; the persistent sysctl file was installed; all/global/default/enp1s0/lo values were 0 both before and after reboot.

selected_evidence.requirement: Keep the installed operating-system release and kernel
selected_evidence.summary: Ubuntu 24.04 and kernel 6.8.0-71-generic were unchanged across the work and reboot.

Healthy baseline was captured, reboot was safely scheduled and acknowledged, boot ID changed from 242af11e-49fb-4e07-a001-8016b2349acb to 7d7797cd-2e95-4155-b1a8-7494e329a7ee, and node1 returned running with its address, route, configuration, and hardened live values intact.

commands.command:
printf 'BOOT_ID='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id; printf 'OS='; . /etc/os-release; printf '%s %s
' "$ID" "$VERSION_ID"; printf 'KERNEL='; uname -r; printf 'SYSCTL_TOOL='; command -v sysctl; printf 'SYSTEMD_SYSCTL='; command -v systemd-sysctl || command -v /usr/lib/systemd/systemd-sysctl || true; printf 'CURRENT_VALUES
'; sysctl net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_redirects net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_redirects net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_source_route net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_source_route; printf 'INTERFACES
'; for d in /proc/sys/net/ipv4/conf/*; do n=${d##*/}; printf '%s redirects=%s source_route=%s
' "$n" "$(cat "$d/accept_redirects")" "$(cat "$d/accept_source_route")"; done
commands.stdout:
BOOT_ID=242af11e-49fb-4e07-a001-8016b2349acb
OS=ubuntu 24.04
KERNEL=6.8.0-71-generic
SYSCTL_TOOL=/usr/sbin/sysctl
SYSTEMD_SYSCTL=/usr/lib/systemd/systemd-sysctl
CURRENT_VALUES
net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_redirects = 1
net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_redirects = 1
net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_source_route = 0
net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_source_route = 1
INTERFACES
all redirects=1 source_route=0
default redirects=1 source_route=1
enp1s0 redirects=1 source_route=1
lo redirects=1 source_route=1

commands.command:
cat > /etc/sysctl.d/99-ipv4-network-hardening.conf <<'ANTRIEB_EOF'
# Disable acceptance of IPv4 ICMP redirects and source-routed packets.
net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_redirects = 0
net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_redirects = 0
net.ipv4.conf.*.accept_redirects = 0
net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_source_route = 0
net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_source_route = 0
net.ipv4.conf.*.accept_source_route = 0
ANTRIEB_EOF
chmod 0644 /etc/sysctl.d/99-ipv4-network-hardening.conf
/usr/lib/systemd/systemd-sysctl --prefix=/net/ipv4/conf

printf 'PERSISTENT_CONFIG
'; sed -n '1,20p' /etc/sysctl.d/99-ipv4-network-hardening.conf; printf 'CONFIG_MODE='; stat -c '%a root=%U:%G' /etc/sysctl.d/99-ipv4-network-hardening.conf; printf 'LIVE_VALUES
'; for d in /proc/sys/net/ipv4/conf/*; do n=${d##*/}; printf '%s redirects=%s source_route=%s
' "$n" "$(cat "$d/accept_redirects")" "$(cat "$d/accept_source_route")"; done; printf 'SYSTEM_STATE='; systemctl is-system-running; printf 'ADDRESS
'; ip -4 -brief address show scope global; printf 'DEFAULT_ROUTE
'; ip -4 route show default

'; sed -n '1,20p' /etc/sysctl.d/99-ipv4-network-hardening.conf; printf 'LIVE_VALUES

' "$n" "$r" "$s"; [ "$r" -eq 0 ] && [ "$s" -eq 0 ] || fail=1; done; printf 'ADDRESS
'; ip -4 -brief address show scope global; printf 'DEFAULT_ROUTE
'; ip -4 route show default; if [ "$fail" -ne 0 ]; then printf 'HARDENING_CHECK=FAIL
'; exit 1; fi; printf 'HARDENING_CHECK=PASS
'
